page.overview:
Who is 14?

The president and CEO of this corporation Anderson Gaulthing referred to the batch of test subjects where 14 was, as the "Psigns of the Times". They were the only ones who survived the experiments. One of the Psigns was his own daughter, Alison Gaulthing.

Alison attempted to escape from the Adrenamix facility and the Psigns were sent to retrieve her. They chased her across a rooftop near Yancy Street, but Alison died while trying to evade capture. 14 and the others began to fear that they would be blamed for her death.

Investigating the Adrenamix activities was the New Warrior known as Justice. Justice fought against the Psigns and was easily defeated. After regaining consciousness, 14 attempted to use her resin against him, but Justice easily deflected the attack.

Next, he reasoned with them by talking about his childhood and past experiences. S for further study pending any criminal proceedings against them.

entity.description: The president and CEO of this corporation Anderson Gaulthing referred to the batch of test subjects where 14 was, as the "Psigns of the Times". They were the only ones who survived the experiments. One of the Psigns was his own daughter, Alison Gaulthing. Alison attempted to escape from the Adrenamix facility and the Psigns were sent to retrieve her. They chased her across a rooftop near Yancy Street, but Alison died while trying to evade capture. 14 and the others began to fear that they would be blamed for her death. Investigating the Adrenamix activities was the New Warrior known as Justice. Justice fought against the Psigns and was easily defeated. After regaining consciousness, 14 attempted to use her resin against him, but Justice easily deflected the attack. Next, he reasoned with them by talking about his childhood and past experiences. Because of that, 14 and the rest of the Psigns of the Times calmed down and were sent to Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S for further study pending any criminal proceedings against them.
